heldout_future_scope: Only the one selected profile, if feasible, may be frozen for separate eight-case6000-step SDK validation after a separate reviewed GO. No runner-up SDK tuning.
scenario_conditioned_gain_family: BrakeKd7 baseline20; othercases baseline2. Shared scale pair is NOT one universal seven-joint gain vector.

metrics.poststate_grid: control tickk=0..749 leads to poststate n=k+1=1..750; use unchanged cached analytic reference frame n
metrics.position_square: F64 sequential accumulation tick0..749 thenjoint0..6: sum += error*error
metrics.iae: each tick row_sum starts0 and adds abs(error) j0..6; IAE += row_sum*0.002; combined case IAEs added case0..3
metrics.terminal: max(abs(qerr)/0.01,abs(rateerr)/0.05) over ALL4cases, all7joints and poststates626..750
metrics.hold_peak: max abs(qpost[j]-q_initial[j]) all750states/joints0..6; computed all4 cases but used case0 only
metrics.peak_speed: all9: maximumabs initial previous_v and all postv
metrics.peak_acceleration: all9 maximumabs(post_v-previous_v)/.002, effective step acceleration, not SDKqacc
metrics.minimum_margin: all9 minimum(qpost-lower,upper-qpost), poststates only; radians for hinges, metres for slides
metrics.independent_oracle: direct-array math.fsum (or Decimal) sums with existing cached analytic references, not only a mirrored streaming recurrence
metrics.F64_policy_layer: independently apply exact feasibility/lex policy to already independently checked score table; additionally disclose accumulation effects if observed
metrics.integer_flags_counts_and_winner: exact; ambiguous thresholds/ties remain failures or explicit observations; no epsilon adjustment

selector.gaps: runner minus winner for all four keys; later-key gaps can be negative
selector.none_feasible: Publish no qualifying candidate; no grid expansion, no best-available promotion, no SDK tuning.

validity.empty_partial: finite invalid cards; goals0, valid0, complete0, reason1 unless an earlier concrete failure

ABI.compact_index: 36x6I64 profile/case/offset_records/count_records/failure_stage/failure_code, profile-major case-major; prefixes retained without fabricated states

numerical_execution_profile: One canonical release/O2 scalar-libm search only. Three new scorer/selector contexts read cached trajectories and do not invoke the plant.
limits: No SDK validation, full robotics stability, collision/contact, global optimality, common-gain controller, hardware, #bounded, typed clock or model-import claim.
